;''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Official Guide Book''
ファイナルファンタジータクティクスアドバンスオフィシャルガイドブック<br />(''Fainaru Fantajī Takutikusu Adobansu Ofisharu Gaido Bukku'')

*Format: Japanese, A4, 159 pages

;''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Ivalice Bible''

*Format: Japanese, A4, 351 pages
*ISBN 978-4-7973-2319-1
;''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Eternal Guide''

*Format: Japanese, A4, 255 pages
*ISBN 978-4-0470-7111-7
;''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Strategy Guide''

*Format: Japanese, A4, 134 pages

*Format: Japanese, A4, 479 pages
*ISBN 978-4-7577-1450-2
;''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance-Grimoire for a thorough investigation''

*Format: Japanese, A4, 511 pages
*ISBN 978-4-8878-7121-2
